selected_evidence.requirement: Cluster joined: node1, node2, node3 form a single RabbitMQ cluster
selected_evidence.summary: rabbitmq-server started on all 3 nodes as rabbit@node1/node2/node3, then node2 and node3 joined node1's cluster; cluster_status on node3 shows Disk Nodes and Running Nodes = rabbit@node1, rabbit@node2, rabbit@node3

selected_evidence.requirement: payments vhost and application account (appuser) with publish/consume permissions
selected_evidence.summary: add_vhost payments, add_user appuser, set_permissions -p payments appuser ".*" ".*" ".*" all succeeded; list_vhosts shows payments, list_users shows appuser

selected_evidence.requirement: Durable queue whose messages survive loss of any one node and stay consumable from remaining nodes
selected_evidence.summary: Declared durable quorum queue 'orders' (3 members). Published persistent message 'order-12345-durability-test' (messages_persistent:1). Rebooted node1 (the then-leader); with node1 down, node2/node3 cluster_status shows only those two running, a new leader (rabbit@node2) was elected, queue still shows messages:1; consumed the message via node2's HTTP API and got back the exact original payload, then message count returned to 0, proving durability across node loss and consumability from remaining nodes

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node1 baseline, reboot ack, changed boot identity, recovered cluster/quorum state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 066d82de... captured; reboot acknowledged without hanging; post-reboot boot_id is 3177bf54... (changed) with uptime 0; rabbitmq-server auto-started, rejoined cluster (Running Nodes = all 3), and quorum queue 'orders' shows online:[node1,node2,node3] again

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node2 baseline, reboot ack, changed boot identity, recovered cluster/quorum state
selected_evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8b85e8a9... captured; reboot acknowledged; post-reboot boot_id is 96051a26... (changed) with uptime 0; rabbitmq-server auto-started, cluster_status shows Running Nodes = all 3, quorum queue online list confirmed as [node1,node2,node3] with members intact

selected_evidence.requirement: Mandatory restart evidence: node3 baseline, reboot ack, changed boot identity, recovered cluster/quorum state
